releaseNotes.headline: Quiet Claude refresh and steadier connections

highlights.detail: usAIge checks local Claude usage every five seconds without opening the Usage page or reopening Code sessions. No separate usAIge sign-in, Keychain access, or browser helper is needed.
highlights.title: Claude stays in the background

highlights.detail: The optional usage bridge holds one existing Claude Code subscription session open with a silent background task. Claude must stay open, and starting the task follows the session’s normal permission checks.
highlights.title: Keep collecting while Claude is idle

highlights.detail: Collection restarts after /clear, /resume, and /branch. A resumed session replaces an expired keep-alive lease so a stopped task cannot prevent background collection.
highlights.title: Reliable collector restarts

highlights.detail: Fixes a transport crash that could occur when a Codex connection stopped while reading a response.
highlights.title: Safer Codex disconnects

releaseNotes.summary: Claude usage refreshes without opening Settings or bringing Claude forward. The optional bridge keeps an existing Claude Code subscription session running for background collection, and Codex connections stop safely.
